verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਦਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: akhee a(n)dhar dhekhadhaa dharasan vich dhisai|

en.bdb: He who sees from inside the eyes, is in fact beholden outside also.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: sabadhai vich vakhaaneeaai suratee vich risai|

en.bdb: He is described through words and He is illumined in the consciousness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਭਵਰੁ ਸਲਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval vich vaasanaa man bhavar salisai|

en.bdb: For the fragrance of the lotus feet of the Guru, the mind, becoming the black bee, enjoys the pleasure.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat sa(n)jog mil vijog na kisai|

en.bdb: Whatever is attained in the holy congregation, he gets not away from it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmat a(n)dhar chit hai chit gurmat jisai|

en.bdb: By putting the mind into the teachings of the Guru, the mind itself changes according to the wisdom of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੈ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham satigur hai tisai ||11||

en.bdb: The true Guru is the form of that transcendental Brahm who is beyond all the qualities.
